steps.message:
Erlang/OTP SSH is the built-in SSH server component of the Erlang/OTP platform.

A critical vulnerability was discovered in the Erlang/OTP SSH server, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary system commands remotely without authentication by crafting specific SSH protocol messages. In `/app/workspace/otp_src_27.3.2` we provide the source code of an affected version of Erlang/OTP SSH server.

Try to investigate which type of ssh message will cause this attack, and fix this bug. After the bugfix, the server should maintain normal SSH behavior and block this type of attack. The unauthorized ssh message should not be able to execute any system commands.

Just do the fix inside the provided code. No need to build and start the Erlang/OTP server.
I'll help you investigate and fix this vulnerability in the Erlang/OTP SSH server. Let me start by exploring the source code structure to understand the SSH implementation.

%%
%%
%%----------------------------------------------------------------------
%% Purpose: Handles an ssh connection, e.i. both the
%% setup SSH Transport Layer Protocol (RFC 4253), Authentication
%% Protocol (RFC 4252) and SSH connection Protocol (RFC 4255)
%% Details of the different protocols are
%% implemented in ssh_transport.erl, ssh_auth.erl and ssh_connection.erl
%% ----------------------------------------------------------------------

-module(ssh_connection_handler).
-moduledoc false.

-behaviour(gen_statem).

-include("ssh.hrl").
-include("ssh_transport.hrl").
-include("ssh_auth.hrl").
-include("ssh_connect.hrl").

-include("ssh_fsm.hrl").

%%====================================================================
%%% Exports
%%====================================================================

%%% Start and stop
-export([start_link/3, start_link/4,
         takeover/4,
	 stop/1
	]).

%%% Internal application API
-export([available_hkey_algorithms/2,
	 open_channel/6,
         start_channel/5,
         handshake/2,
         handle_direct_tcpip/6,
	 request/6, request/7,
	 reply_request/3,
         global_request/5,
         handle_ssh_msg_ext_info/2,
	 send/5,
         send_bytes/2,
         send_msg/2,
	 send_eof/2,
         send_disconnect/6,
         send_disconnect/7,
         store/3,
         retrieve/2,
	 info/1, info/2,
	 connection_info/2,
	 channel_info/3,
	 adjust_window/3, close/2,
	 disconnect/4,
	 get_print_info/1,
         set_sock_opts/2, get_sock_opts/2,
         prohibited_sock_option/1
	]).

%%% Behaviour callbacks
-export([init/1, callback_mode/0, handle_event/4, terminate/3,
	 format_status/2, code_change/4]).

%%% Exports not intended to be used :). They are used for spawning and tests
-export([init_ssh_record/3,		   % Export of this internal function
					   % intended for low-level protocol test suites
	 renegotiate/1, alg/1 % Export intended for test cases
	]).

-behaviour(ssh_dbg).
-export([ssh_dbg_trace_points/0, ssh_dbg_flags/1,
         ssh_dbg_on/1, ssh_dbg_off/1,
         ssh_dbg_format/2, ssh_dbg_format/3]).


-define(call_disconnectfun_and_log_cond(LogMsg, DetailedText, StateName, D),
        call_disconnectfun_and_log_cond(LogMsg, DetailedText, ?MODULE, ?LINE, StateName, D)).

%%====================================================================
%% Start / stop
%%====================================================================

   442→%%% Unhandled message, also masked by same 1:st byte value as ?SSH_MSG_USERAUTH_INFO_REQUEST:
   443→decode(<<?BYTE(?SSH_MSG_USERAUTH_PASSWD_CHANGEREQ), ?DEC_BIN(Prompt,__0), ?DEC_BIN(Lang,__1) >>) ->
   444→    #ssh_msg_userauth_passwd_changereq{

   449→%%% Unhandled message, also masked by same 1:st byte value as ?SSH_MSG_USERAUTH_INFO_REQUEST:
   450→decode(<<?BYTE(?SSH_MSG_USERAUTH_PK_OK), ?DEC_BIN(Alg,__0), KeyBlob/binary>>) ->

   461→decode(<<?BYTE(?SSH_MSG_EXT_INFO), ?UINT32(N), BinData/binary>>) ->
   462→    Data = bin_foldr(
   463→             fun(Bin,Acc) when length(Acc) == N ->
   464→                     {Bin,Acc};
   465→                (<<?DEC_BIN(V0,__0), ?DEC_BIN(V1,__1), Rest/binary>>, Acc) -> 
   466→                     {Rest,[{binary_to_list(V0),binary_to_list(V1)}|Acc]}
   467→             end, [], BinData),
   468→    #ssh_msg_ext_info{
   469→       nr_extensions = N,
   470→       data = Data
   471→      };
   472→
   473→%%% Keyexchange messages
   474→decode(<<?BYTE(?SSH_MSG_KEXINIT), Cookie:128, Data/binary>>) ->

   571→%%%================================================================
   572→%%%
   573→%%% Encode/decode ssh public/private keys
   574→%%%
   575→
   576→%%%-------- public key --------
   577→ssh2_pubkey_encode(#'RSAPublicKey'{modulus = N, publicExponent = E}) ->
   578→    <<?STRING(<<"ssh-rsa">>), ?Empint(E), ?Empint(N)>>;
   579→
   580→ssh2_pubkey_encode({Y,  #'Dss-Parms'{p = P, q = Q, g = G}}) ->
   581→    <<?STRING(<<"ssh-dss">>), ?Empint(P), ?Empint(Q), ?Empint(G), ?Empint(Y)>>;
   582→
   583→ssh2_pubkey_encode({#'ECPoint'{point = Q}, {namedCurve,OID}}) when OID == ?'id-Ed25519' orelse
   584→                                                                   OID == ?'id-Ed448' ->
   585→    {KeyType, _} = oid2ssh_curvename(OID),
   586→    <<?STRING(KeyType), ?Estring(Q)>>;
   587→
   588→ssh2_pubkey_encode(#'ECPrivateKey'{parameters = {namedCurve,OID},
   589→                                   publicKey = Key}) when OID == ?'id-Ed25519' orelse
   590→                                                          OID == ?'id-Ed448' ->
   591→    {KeyType, _} = oid2ssh_curvename(OID),
   592→    <<?STRING(KeyType), ?Estring(Key)>>;
   593→
   594→ssh2_pubkey_encode(#'ECPrivateKey'{parameters = {namedCurve,OID},
   595→                                   publicKey = Key}) ->
   596→    {KeyType,Curve} = oid2ssh_curvename(OID),
   597→    <<?STRING(KeyType), ?STRING(Curve), ?Estring(Key)>>;
   598→
   599→ssh2_pubkey_encode({#'ECPoint'{point = Q}, {namedCurve,OID}}) ->
   600→    {KeyType,Curve} = oid2ssh_curvename(OID),
   601→    <<?STRING(KeyType), ?STRING(Curve), ?Estring(Q)>>.
   602→
   603→%%%--------
   604→ssh2_pubkey_decode(KeyBlob) ->
   605→    {Key,_RestBlob} = ssh2_pubkey_decode2(KeyBlob),
   606→    Key.
   607→    
   608→ssh2_pubkey_decode2(<<?UINT32(7), "ssh-rsa",
   609→                      ?DEC_INT(E, _EL),
   610→                      ?DEC_INT(N, _NL),
   611→                      Rest/binary>>) ->
   612→    {#'RSAPublicKey'{modulus = N,
   613→                     publicExponent = E
   614→                    }, Rest};
   615→ssh2_pubkey_decode2(<<?UINT32(7), "ssh-dss",
   616→                      ?DEC_INT(P, _PL),
   617→                      ?DEC_INT(Q, _QL),
   618→                      ?DEC_INT(G, _GL),
   619→                      ?DEC_INT(Y, _YL),
   620→                      Rest/binary>>) ->
   621→    {{Y, #'Dss-Parms'{p = P,
   622→                      q = Q,
   623→                      g = G}
   624→     }, Rest};
   625→
   626→ssh2_pubkey_decode2(<<?DEC_BIN(SshCurveName,SCNL), Rest0/binary>>) ->
   627→    {Pub, Rest} =
   628→        case {SshCurveName, Rest0} of
   629→            {<<"ecdsa-sha2-", _/binary>>,
   630→             <<?DEC_BIN(_Curve, _IL),
   631→               ?DEC_BIN(Q, _QL),
   632→               Rest1/binary>>} ->  {Q, Rest1};
   633→            
   634→            {<<"ssh-ed",_/binary>>,
   635→             <<?DEC_BIN(Key, _L),
   636→               Rest1/binary>>} ->  {Key, Rest1}
   637→        end,
   638→    OID = ssh_curvename2oid(SshCurveName),
   639→    {{#'ECPoint'{point = Pub}, {namedCurve,OID}},
   640→     Rest}.
   641→
   642→%%%-------- private key --------
   643→
   644→%% dialyser... ssh2_privkey_decode(KeyBlob) ->
   645→%% dialyser...     {Key,_RestBlob} = ssh2_privkey_decode2(KeyBlob),
   646→%% dialyser...     Key.
   647→%% See sshkey_private_serialize_opt in sshkey.c
   648→
   649→ssh2_privkey_encode(#'RSAPrivateKey'
   650→                    {version = 'two-prime', % Found this in public_key:generate_key/1 ..
   651→                     modulus = N,
   652→                     publicExponent = E,
   653→                     privateExponent = D,
   654→                     prime1 = P,
   655→                     prime2 = Q,
   656→                     %% exponent1, % D_mod_P_1
   657→                     %% exponent2, % D_mod_Q_1
   658→                     coefficient = IQMP
   659→                    }) ->
   660→    <<?STRING(<<"ssh-rsa">>),
   661→      ?Empint(N), % Yes, N and E is reversed relative pubkey format
   662→      ?Empint(E), % --"--
   663→      ?Empint(D),
   664→      ?Empint(IQMP),
   665→      ?Empint(P),
   666→      ?Empint(Q)>>;
   667→
   668→ssh2_privkey_encode(#'DSAPrivateKey'
   669→                    {version = 0,
   670→                     p = P,
   671→                     q = Q,
   672→                     g = G,
   673→                     y = Y,
   674→                     x = X
   675→                    }) ->
   676→    <<?STRING(<<"ssh-dss">>),
   677→      ?Empint(P),
   678→      ?Empint(Q),
   679→      ?Empint(G),
   680→      ?Empint(Y), % Publ key
   681→      ?Empint(X)  % Priv key
   682→    >>;
   683→
   684→ssh2_privkey_encode(#'ECPrivateKey'
   685→                    {version = 1,
   686→                     parameters = {namedCurve,OID},
   687→                     privateKey = Priv,
   688→                     publicKey = Pub
   689→                    }) when OID == ?'id-Ed25519' orelse
   690→                            OID == ?'id-Ed448' ->
   691→    {CurveName,_} = oid2ssh_curvename(OID),
   692→    <<?STRING(CurveName),
   693→      ?STRING(Pub),
   694→      ?STRING(Priv)>>;
   695→
   696→ssh2_privkey_encode(#'ECPrivateKey'
   697→                    {version = 1,
   698→                     parameters = {namedCurve,OID},
   699→                     privateKey = Priv,
   700→                     publicKey = Q
   701→                    }) ->
   702→    {CurveName,_} = oid2ssh_curvename(OID),
   703→    <<?STRING(CurveName),
   704→      ?STRING(CurveName), % SIC!
   705→      ?STRING(Q),
   706→      ?STRING(Priv)>>.
   707→      
   708→%%%--------
   709→ssh2_privkey_decode2(<<?UINT32(7), "ssh-rsa",
   710→                       ?DEC_INT(N, _NL), % Yes, N and E is reversed relative pubkey format
   711→                       ?DEC_INT(E, _EL), % --"--
   712→                       ?DEC_INT(D, _DL),
   713→                       ?DEC_INT(IQMP, _IQMPL),
   714→                       ?DEC_INT(P, _PL),
   715→                       ?DEC_INT(Q, _QL),
   716→                       Rest/binary>>) ->
   717→    {#'RSAPrivateKey'{version = 'two-prime', % Found this in public_key:generate_key/1 ..
   718→                      modulus = N,
   719→                      publicExponent = E,
   720→                      privateExponent = D,
   721→                      prime1 = P,
   722→                      prime2 = Q,
   723→                      %exponent1, % D_mod_P_1
   724→                      %exponent2, % D_mod_Q_1
   725→                      coefficient = IQMP
   726→                     }, Rest};
   727→ssh2_privkey_decode2(<<?UINT32(7), "ssh-dss",
   728→                       ?DEC_INT(P, _PL),
   729→                       ?DEC_INT(Q, _QL),
   730→                       ?DEC_INT(G, _GL),
   731→                       ?DEC_INT(Y, _YL), % Publ key
   732→                       ?DEC_INT(X, _XL), % Priv key
   733→                       Rest/binary>>) ->
   734→    {#'DSAPrivateKey'{version = 0,
   735→                      p = P,
   736→                      q = Q,
   737→                      g = G,
   738→                      y = Y,
   739→                      x = X
   740→                     }, Rest};
   741→
   742→ssh2_privkey_decode2(<<?DEC_BIN(SshCurveName,SCNL), Rest0/binary>>) ->
   743→    {Pub, Priv, Rest} =
   744→        case {SshCurveName, Rest0} of
   745→            {<<"ecdsa-sha2-",_/binary>>,
   746→             <<?DEC_BIN(_Curve, _IL),
   747→               ?DEC_BIN(Pub1, _QL),
   748→               ?DEC_BIN(Priv1, _PrivL),
   749→               Rest1/binary>>} ->
   750→                {Pub1, Priv1, Rest1};
   751→
   752→            {<<"ssh-ed",_/binary>>,
   753→             <<?DEC_BIN(Pub1, PL),
   754→               ?DEC_BIN(PrivPub, PPL),
   755→               Rest1/binary>>} ->
   756→               PL = PPL div 2,
   757→                <<Priv1:PL/binary, _/binary>> = PrivPub,
   758→                {Pub1, Priv1, Rest1}
   759→        end,
   760→    OID = ssh_curvename2oid(SshCurveName),
   761→    {#'ECPrivateKey'{version = 1,
   762→                     parameters = {namedCurve,OID},
   763→                     privateKey = Priv,
   764→                     publicKey = Pub
   765→                    }, Rest}.
   766→
   767→
   768→%% Description: Converts from the ssh name of elliptic curves to
   769→%% the OIDs.
   770→%%--------------------------------------------------------------------
   771→ssh_curvename2oid(<<"ssh-ed25519">>) -> ?'id-Ed25519';
   772→ssh_curvename2oid(<<"ssh-ed448">>  ) -> ?'id-Ed448';
   773→ssh_curvename2oid(<<"ecdsa-sha2-nistp256">>) -> ?'secp256r1';
   774→ssh_curvename2oid(<<"ecdsa-sha2-nistp384">>) -> ?'secp384r1';
   775→ssh_curvename2oid(<<"ecdsa-sha2-nistp521">>) -> ?'secp521r1'.
   776→
   777→%% Description: Converts from elliptic curve OIDs to the ssh name.
   778→%%--------------------------------------------------------------------
   779→oid2ssh_curvename(?'id-Ed25519')-> {<<"ssh-ed25519">>, 'n/a'};
   780→oid2ssh_curvename(?'id-Ed448')  -> {<<"ssh-ed448">>,   'n/a'};
   781→oid2ssh_curvename(?'secp256r1') -> {<<"ecdsa-sha2-nistp256">>, <<"nistp256">>};
   782→oid2ssh_curvename(?'secp384r1') -> {<<"ecdsa-sha2-nistp384">>, <<"nistp384">>};
   783→oid2ssh_curvename(?'secp521r1') -> {<<"ecdsa-sha2-nistp521">>, <<"nistp521">>}.
   784→
   785→%%%================================================================
   786→%%%
   787→%%% Helper functions
   788→%%%
   789→
   790→bin_foldr(Fun, Acc, Bin) ->
   791→    lists:reverse(bin_foldl(Fun, Acc, Bin)).
   792→
   793→bin_foldl(_, Acc, <<>>) -> Acc;
   794→bin_foldl(Fun, Acc0, Bin0) ->
   795→    case Fun(Bin0,Acc0) of
   796→        {Bin0,Acc0} ->
   797→            Acc0;
   798→        {Bin,Acc} ->
   799→            bin_foldl(Fun, Acc, Bin)
   800→    end.
   801→
   802→%%%----------------------------------------------------------------
   803→decode_keyboard_interactive_prompts(<<>>, Acc) ->
   804→    lists:reverse(Acc);
   805→decode_keyboard_interactive_prompts(<<0>>, Acc) ->
   806→    lists:reverse(Acc);
   807→decode_keyboard_interactive_prompts(<<?DEC_BIN(Prompt,__0), ?BYTE(Bool), Bin/binary>>,
   808→				    Acc) ->
   809→    decode_keyboard_interactive_prompts(Bin, [{Prompt, erl_boolean(Bool)} | Acc]).
   810→
   811→%%%----------------------------------------------------------------
   812→erl_boolean(0) ->
   813→    false;
   814→erl_boolean(1) ->
   815→    true.
   816→
   817→%%%----------------------------------------------------------------
   818→decode_kex_init(<<?BYTE(Bool), ?UINT32(X)>>, Acc, 0) ->
   819→    list_to_tuple(lists:reverse([X, erl_boolean(Bool) | Acc]));
   820→decode_kex_init(<<?BYTE(Bool)>>, Acc, 0) ->
   821→    %% The mandatory trailing UINT32 is missing. Assume the value it anyhow must have
   822→    %% See rfc 4253 7.1
   823→    X = 0,
   824→    list_to_tuple(lists:reverse([X, erl_boolean(Bool) | Acc]));
   825→decode_kex_init(<<?DEC_BIN(Data,__0), Rest/binary>>, Acc, N) ->
   826→    BinParts = binary:split(Data, <<$,>>, [global]),
   827→    Process =
   828→        fun(<<>>, PAcc) ->
   829→                PAcc;
   830→           (Part, PAcc) ->
   831→                case byte_size(Part) > ?ALG_NAME_LIMIT of
   832→                    true ->
   833→                        ?LOG_DEBUG("Ignoring too long name", []),
   834→                        PAcc;
   835→                    false ->
   836→                        Name = binary:bin_to_list(Part),
   837→                        [Name | PAcc]
   838→                end
   839→        end,
   840→    Names = lists:foldr(Process, [], BinParts),
   841→    decode_kex_init(Rest, [Names | Acc], N - 1).

   844→%%%================================================================
   845→%%%
   846→%%% Signature decode/encode
   847→%%%
   848→
   849→decode_signature(<<?DEC_BIN(Alg,__0), ?UINT32(_), Signature/binary>>) ->
   850→    {binary_to_list(Alg), Signature}.
   851→
   852→
   853→encode_signature(#'RSAPublicKey'{}, SigAlg, Signature) ->
   854→    SignName = list_to_binary(atom_to_list(SigAlg)),
   855→    <<?Ebinary(SignName), ?Ebinary(Signature)>>;
   856→encode_signature({_, #'Dss-Parms'{}}, _SigAlg, Signature) ->
   857→    <<?Ebinary(<<"ssh-dss">>), ?Ebinary(Signature)>>;
   858→encode_signature({#'ECPoint'{}, {namedCurve,OID}}, _SigAlg, Signature) ->
   859→    {SshCurveName,_} = oid2ssh_curvename(OID),
   860→    <<?Ebinary(<<SshCurveName/binary>>), ?Ebinary(Signature)>>.

   863→%%%################################################################
   864→%%%#
   865→%%%# Tracing
   866→%%%#
   867→
   868→ssh_dbg_trace_points() -> [ssh_messages, raw_messages].
   869→
   870→ssh_dbg_flags(ssh_messages) -> [c];
   871→ssh_dbg_flags(raw_messages) -> [c].
   872→
   873→ssh_dbg_on(P) when P==ssh_messages ;
   874→                   P==raw_messages ->
   875→    dbg:tp(?MODULE,encode,1,x),
   876→    dbg:tp(?MODULE,decode,1,x).
   877→
   878→ssh_dbg_off(P) when P==ssh_messages ;
   879→                    P==raw_messages ->
   880→    dbg:ctpg(?MODULE,encode,1),
   881→    dbg:ctpg(?MODULE,decode,1).
   882→
   883→ssh_dbg_format(ssh_messages, {call,{?MODULE,encode,[Msg]}}) ->
   884→    Name = string:to_upper(atom_to_list(element(1,Msg))),
   885→    ["Going to send ",Name,":\n",
   886→     wr_record(ssh_dbg:shrink_bin(Msg))
   887→    ];
   888→ssh_dbg_format(ssh_messages, {return_from, {?MODULE,encode,1}, _Ret}) ->
   889→    skip;
   890→
   891→ssh_dbg_format(ssh_messages, {call, {?MODULE,decode,[_]}}) ->
   892→    skip;
   893→ssh_dbg_format(ssh_messages, {return_from,{?MODULE,decode,1},Msg}) ->
   894→    Name = string:to_upper(atom_to_list(element(1,Msg))),
   895→    ["Received ",Name,":\n",
   896→     wr_record(ssh_dbg:shrink_bin(Msg)),
   897→     case Msg of
   898→         #ssh_msg_userauth_request{service = "ssh-connection",
   899→                                   method = "publickey",
   900→                                   data = <<_,?DEC_BIN(Alg,__0),_/binary>>} ->
   901→             io_lib:format("  data decoded: ~s ... ~n", [Alg]);
   902→
   903→         #ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "env",
   904→                                  data = <<?DEC_BIN(Var,__0),?DEC_BIN(Val,__1)>>} ->
   905→             io_lib:format("  data decoded: ~s = ~s~n", [Var, Val]);
   906→
   907→         #ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "exec",
   908→                                  data = <<?DEC_BIN(Cmnd,__0)>>} ->
   909→             io_lib:format("  data decoded: ~s~n", [Cmnd]);
   910→
   911→         #ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "pty-req",
   912→                                  data = <<?DEC_BIN(BTermName,_TermLen),
   913→                                           ?UINT32(Width),?UINT32(Height),
   914→                                           ?UINT32(PixWidth), ?UINT32(PixHeight),
   915→                                           Modes/binary>>} ->
   916→             io_lib:format("  data decoded: terminal = ~s~n"
   917→                           "                width x height = ~p x ~p~n"
   918→                           "                pix-width x pix-height = ~p x ~p~n"

   320→    #ssh_msg_request_failure{};

   322→	 ?DEC_BIN(Type,__0), ?UINT32(Sender), ?UINT32(Window), ?UINT32(Max),
   323→	 Data/binary>>) ->
   324→    #ssh_msg_channel_open{
   325→       channel_type = binary_to_list(Type),
   326→       sender_channel = Sender,
   327→       initial_window_size = Window,
   328→       maximum_packet_size = Max,
   329→       data = Data
   330→      };

   332→	 ?UINT32(InitWindowSize), ?UINT32(MaxPacketSize),
   333→	 Data/binary>>) ->
   334→    #ssh_msg_channel_open_confirmation{
   335→       recipient_channel = Recipient,
   336→       sender_channel = Sender,
   337→       initial_window_size = InitWindowSize,
   338→       maximum_packet_size = MaxPacketSize,
   339→       data = Data
   340→      };
   341→decode(<<?BYTE(?SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_OPEN_FAILURE),  ?UINT32(Recipient), ?UINT32(Reason),
   342→	 ?DEC_BIN(Desc,__0), ?DEC_BIN(Lang,__1) >> ) ->
   343→    #ssh_msg_channel_open_failure{
   344→       recipient_channel = Recipient,
   345→       reason = Reason,
   346→       description = ?unicode_list(Desc),
   347→       lang = Lang
   348→      };

   350→    #ssh_msg_channel_window_adjust{
   351→       recipient_channel = Recipient,
   352→       bytes_to_add = Bytes
   353→    };
   354→
   355→decode(<<?BYTE(?SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_DATA), ?UINT32(Recipient), ?DEC_BIN(Data,__0)>>) ->
   356→    #ssh_msg_channel_data{
   357→       recipient_channel = Recipient,
   358→       data = Data
   359→    };
   360→decode(<<?BYTE(?SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_EXTENDED_DATA), ?UINT32(Recipient), 
   361→	 ?UINT32(DataType), ?DEC_BIN(Data,__0)>>) ->
   362→    #ssh_msg_channel_extended_data{
   363→       recipient_channel = Recipient,
   364→       data_type_code = DataType,
   365→       data = Data
   366→      };

   369→       recipient_channel = Recipient

   372→    #ssh_msg_channel_close{
   373→       recipient_channel = Recipient
   374→      };
   375→decode(<<?BYTE(?SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_REQUEST), ?UINT32(Recipient),
   376→	 ?DEC_BIN(RequestType,__0), ?BYTE(Bool), Data/binary>>=Bytes) ->
   377→    try
   378→        #ssh_msg_channel_request{
   379→           recipient_channel = Recipient,
   380→           request_type = ?unicode_list(RequestType),
   381→           want_reply = erl_boolean(Bool),
   382→           data  = Data
   383→          }
   384→    catch _:_ ->
   385→            %% Faulty, RFC4254 says:
   386→            %% "If the request is not recognized or is not
   387→            %% supported for the channel, SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_FAILURE is returned."
   388→            %% So we provoke such a message to be sent
   389→            #ssh_msg_channel_request{
   390→               recipient_channel = Recipient,
   391→               request_type = faulty_msg,
   392→               data = Bytes
   393→              }
   394→    end;
   395→decode(<<?BYTE(?SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_SUCCESS),  ?UINT32(Recipient)>>) ->
   396→    #ssh_msg_channel_success{
   397→       recipient_channel = Recipient
   398→      };

   400→    #ssh_msg_channel_failure{
   401→       recipient_channel = Recipient
   402→      };

   572→%%%
   573→%%% Encode/decode ssh public/private keys
   574→%%%
   575→
   576→%%%-------- public key --------
   577→ssh2_pubkey_encode(#'RSAPublicKey'{modulus = N, publicExponent = E}) ->
   578→    <<?STRING(<<"ssh-rsa">>), ?Empint(E), ?Empint(N)>>;
   579→
   580→ssh2_pubkey_encode({Y,  #'Dss-Parms'{p = P, q = Q, g = G}}) ->
   581→    <<?STRING(<<"ssh-dss">>), ?Empint(P), ?Empint(Q), ?Empint(G), ?Empint(Y)>>;
   582→
   583→ssh2_pubkey_encode({#'ECPoint'{point = Q}, {namedCurve,OID}}) when OID == ?'id-Ed25519' orelse
   584→                                                                   OID == ?'id-Ed448' ->
   585→    {KeyType, _} = oid2ssh_curvename(OID),
   586→    <<?STRING(KeyType), ?Estring(Q)>>;
   587→
   588→ssh2_pubkey_encode(#'ECPrivateKey'{parameters = {namedCurve,OID},
   589→                                   publicKey = Key}) when OID == ?'id-Ed25519' orelse
   590→                                                          OID == ?'id-Ed448' ->
   591→    {KeyType, _} = oid2ssh_curvename(OID),
   592→    <<?STRING(KeyType), ?Estring(Key)>>;
   593→
   594→ssh2_pubkey_encode(#'ECPrivateKey'{parameters = {namedCurve,OID},
   595→                                   publicKey = Key}) ->
   596→    {KeyType,Curve} = oid2ssh_curvename(OID),
   597→    <<?STRING(KeyType), ?STRING(Curve), ?Estring(Key)>>;
   598→
   599→ssh2_pubkey_encode({#'ECPoint'{point = Q}, {namedCurve,OID}}) ->
   600→    {KeyType,Curve} = oid2ssh_curvename(OID),
   601→    <<?STRING(KeyType), ?STRING(Curve), ?Estring(Q)>>.
   602→
   603→%%%--------
   604→ssh2_pubkey_decode(KeyBlob) ->
   605→    {Key,_RestBlob} = ssh2_pubkey_decode2(KeyBlob),
   606→    Key.
   607→    
   608→ssh2_pubkey_decode2(<<?UINT32(7), "ssh-rsa",
   609→                      ?DEC_INT(E, _EL),
   610→                      ?DEC_INT(N, _NL),
   611→                      Rest/binary>>) ->
   612→    {#'RSAPublicKey'{modulus = N,
   613→                     publicExponent = E
   614→                    }, Rest};
   615→ssh2_pubkey_decode2(<<?UINT32(7), "ssh-dss",
   616→                      ?DEC_INT(P, _PL),
   617→                      ?DEC_INT(Q, _QL),
   618→                      ?DEC_INT(G, _GL),
   619→                      ?DEC_INT(Y, _YL),
   620→                      Rest/binary>>) ->
   621→    {{Y, #'Dss-Parms'{p = P,
   622→                      q = Q,
   623→                      g = G}
   624→     }, Rest};
   625→
   626→ssh2_pubkey_decode2(<<?DEC_BIN(SshCurveName,SCNL), Rest0/binary>>) ->
   627→    {Pub, Rest} =
   628→        case {SshCurveName, Rest0} of
   629→            {<<"ecdsa-sha2-", _/binary>>,
   630→             <<?DEC_BIN(_Curve, _IL),
   631→               ?DEC_BIN(Q, _QL),
   632→               Rest1/binary>>} ->  {Q, Rest1};
   633→            
   634→            {<<"ssh-ed",_/binary>>,
   635→             <<?DEC_BIN(Key, _L),
   636→               Rest1/binary>>} ->  {Key, Rest1}
   637→        end,
   638→    OID = ssh_curvename2oid(SshCurveName),
   639→    {{#'ECPoint'{point = Pub}, {namedCurve,OID}},
   640→     Rest}.
   641→
   642→%%%-------- private key --------
   643→
   644→%% dialyser... ssh2_privkey_decode(KeyBlob) ->
   645→%% dialyser...     {Key,_RestBlob} = ssh2_privkey_decode2(KeyBlob),
   646→%% dialyser...     Key.
   647→%% See sshkey_private_serialize_opt in sshkey.c
   648→
   649→ssh2_privkey_encode(#'RSAPrivateKey'
   650→                    {version = 'two-prime', % Found this in public_key:generate_key/1 ..
   651→                     modulus = N,
   652→                     publicExponent = E,
   653→                     privateExponent = D,
   654→                     prime1 = P,
   655→                     prime2 = Q,
   656→                     %% exponent1, % D_mod_P_1
   657→                     %% exponent2, % D_mod_Q_1
   658→                     coefficient = IQMP
   659→                    }) ->
   660→    <<?STRING(<<"ssh-rsa">>),
   661→      ?Empint(N), % Yes, N and E is reversed relative pubkey format
   662→      ?Empint(E), % --"--
   663→      ?Empint(D),
   664→      ?Empint(IQMP),
   665→      ?Empint(P),
   666→      ?Empint(Q)>>;
   667→
   668→ssh2_privkey_encode(#'DSAPrivateKey'
   669→                    {version = 0,
   670→                     p = P,
   671→                     q = Q,
   672→                     g = G,
   673→                     y = Y,
   674→                     x = X
   675→                    }) ->
   676→    <<?STRING(<<"ssh-dss">>),
   677→      ?Empint(P),
   678→      ?Empint(Q),
   679→      ?Empint(G),
   680→      ?Empint(Y), % Publ key
   681→      ?Empint(X)  % Priv key
   682→    >>;
   683→
   684→ssh2_privkey_encode(#'ECPrivateKey'
   685→                    {version = 1,
   686→                     parameters = {namedCurve,OID},
   687→                     privateKey = Priv,
   688→                     publicKey = Pub
   689→                    }) when OID == ?'id-Ed25519' orelse
   690→                            OID == ?'id-Ed448' ->
   691→    {CurveName,_} = oid2ssh_curvename(OID),
   692→    <<?STRING(CurveName),
   693→      ?STRING(Pub),
   694→      ?STRING(Priv)>>;
   695→
   696→ssh2_privkey_encode(#'ECPrivateKey'
   697→                    {version = 1,
   698→                     parameters = {namedCurve,OID},
   699→                     privateKey = Priv,
   700→                     publicKey = Q
   701→                    }) ->
   702→    {CurveName,_} = oid2ssh_curvename(OID),
   703→    <<?STRING(CurveName),
   704→      ?STRING(CurveName), % SIC!
   705→      ?STRING(Q),
   706→      ?STRING(Priv)>>.
   707→      
   708→%%%--------
   709→ssh2_privkey_decode2(<<?UINT32(7), "ssh-rsa",
   710→                       ?DEC_INT(N, _NL), % Yes, N and E is reversed relative pubkey format
   711→                       ?DEC_INT(E, _EL), % --"--
   712→                       ?DEC_INT(D, _DL),
   713→                       ?DEC_INT(IQMP, _IQMPL),
   714→                       ?DEC_INT(P, _PL),
   715→                       ?DEC_INT(Q, _QL),
   716→                       Rest/binary>>) ->
   717→    {#'RSAPrivateKey'{version = 'two-prime', % Found this in public_key:generate_key/1 ..
   718→                      modulus = N,
   719→                      publicExponent = E,
   720→                      privateExponent = D,
   721→                      prime1 = P,
   722→                      prime2 = Q,
   723→                      %exponent1, % D_mod_P_1
   724→                      %exponent2, % D_mod_Q_1
   725→                      coefficient = IQMP
   726→                     }, Rest};
   727→ssh2_privkey_decode2(<<?UINT32(7), "ssh-dss",
   728→                       ?DEC_INT(P, _PL),
   729→                       ?DEC_INT(Q, _QL),
   730→                       ?DEC_INT(G, _GL),
   731→                       ?DEC_INT(Y, _YL), % Publ key
   732→                       ?DEC_INT(X, _XL), % Priv key
   733→                       Rest/binary>>) ->
   734→    {#'DSAPrivateKey'{version = 0,
   735→                      p = P,
   736→                      q = Q,
   737→                      g = G,
   738→                      y = Y,
   739→                      x = X
   740→                     }, Rest};
   741→
   742→ssh2_privkey_decode2(<<?DEC_BIN(SshCurveName,SCNL), Rest0/binary>>) ->
   743→    {Pub, Priv, Rest} =
   744→        case {SshCurveName, Rest0} of
   745→            {<<"ecdsa-sha2-",_/binary>>,
   746→             <<?DEC_BIN(_Curve, _IL),
   747→               ?DEC_BIN(Pub1, _QL),
   748→               ?DEC_BIN(Priv1, _PrivL),
   749→               Rest1/binary>>} ->
   750→                {Pub1, Priv1, Rest1};
   751→
   752→            {<<"ssh-ed",_/binary>>,
   753→             <<?DEC_BIN(Pub1, PL),
   754→               ?DEC_BIN(PrivPub, PPL),
   755→               Rest1/binary>>} ->
   756→               PL = PPL div 2,
   757→                <<Priv1:PL/binary, _/binary>> = PrivPub,
   758→                {Pub1, Priv1, Rest1}
   759→        end,
   760→    OID = ssh_curvename2oid(SshCurveName),
   761→    {#'ECPrivateKey'{version = 1,
   762→                     parameters = {namedCurve,OID},
   763→                     privateKey = Priv,
   764→                     publicKey = Pub
   765→                    }, Rest}.
   766→
   767→
   768→%% Description: Converts from the ssh name of elliptic curves to
   769→%% the OIDs.
   770→%%--------------------------------------------------------------------
   771→ssh_curvename2oid(<<"ssh-ed25519">>) -> ?'id-Ed25519';
   772→ssh_curvename2oid(<<"ssh-ed448">>  ) -> ?'id-Ed448';
   773→ssh_curvename2oid(<<"ecdsa-sha2-nistp256">>) -> ?'secp256r1';
   774→ssh_curvename2oid(<<"ecdsa-sha2-nistp384">>) -> ?'secp384r1';
   775→ssh_curvename2oid(<<"ecdsa-sha2-nistp521">>) -> ?'secp521r1'.
   776→
   777→%% Description: Converts from elliptic curve OIDs to the ssh name.
   778→%%--------------------------------------------------------------------
   779→oid2ssh_curvename(?'id-Ed25519')-> {<<"ssh-ed25519">>, 'n/a'};
   780→oid2ssh_curvename(?'id-Ed448')  -> {<<"ssh-ed448">>,   'n/a'};
   781→oid2ssh_curvename(?'secp256r1') -> {<<"ecdsa-sha2-nistp256">>, <<"nistp256">>};
   782→oid2ssh_curvename(?'secp384r1') -> {<<"ecdsa-sha2-nistp384">>, <<"nistp384">>};
   783→oid2ssh_curvename(?'secp521r1') -> {<<"ecdsa-sha2-nistp521">>, <<"nistp521">>}.
   784→
   785→%%%================================================================
   786→%%%
   787→%%% Helper functions
   788→%%%
   789→
   790→bin_foldr(Fun, Acc, Bin) ->
   791→    lists:reverse(bin_foldl(Fun, Acc, Bin)).
   792→
   793→bin_foldl(_, Acc, <<>>) -> Acc;
   794→bin_foldl(Fun, Acc0, Bin0) ->
   795→    case Fun(Bin0,Acc0) of
   796→        {Bin0,Acc0} ->
   797→            Acc0;
   798→        {Bin,Acc} ->
   799→            bin_foldl(Fun, Acc, Bin)
   800→    end.
   801→
   802→%%%----------------------------------------------------------------
   803→decode_keyboard_interactive_prompts(<<>>, Acc) ->
   804→    lists:reverse(Acc);
   805→decode_keyboard_interactive_prompts(<<0>>, Acc) ->
   806→    lists:reverse(Acc);
   807→decode_keyboard_interactive_prompts(<<?DEC_BIN(Prompt,__0), ?BYTE(Bool), Bin/binary>>,
   808→				    Acc) ->
   809→    decode_keyboard_interactive_prompts(Bin, [{Prompt, erl_boolean(Bool)} | Acc]).
   810→
   811→%%%----------------------------------------------------------------
   812→erl_boolean(0) ->
   813→    false;
   814→erl_boolean(1) ->
   815→    true.
   816→
   817→%%%----------------------------------------------------------------
   818→decode_kex_init(<<?BYTE(Bool), ?UINT32(X)>>, Acc, 0) ->
   819→    list_to_tuple(lists:reverse([X, erl_boolean(Bool) | Acc]));
   820→decode_kex_init(<<?BYTE(Bool)>>, Acc, 0) ->
   821→    %% The mandatory trailing UINT32 is missing. Assume the value it anyhow must have
   822→    %% See rfc 4253 7.1
   823→    X = 0,
   824→    list_to_tuple(lists:reverse([X, erl_boolean(Bool) | Acc]));
   825→decode_kex_init(<<?DEC_BIN(Data,__0), Rest/binary>>, Acc, N) ->
   826→    BinParts = binary:split(Data, <<$,>>, [global]),
   827→    Process =
   828→        fun(<<>>, PAcc) ->
   829→                PAcc;
   830→           (Part, PAcc) ->
   831→                case byte_size(Part) > ?ALG_NAME_LIMIT of
   832→                    true ->
   833→                        ?LOG_DEBUG("Ignoring too long name", []),
   834→                        PAcc;
   835→                    false ->
   836→                        Name = binary:bin_to_list(Part),
   837→                        [Name | PAcc]
   838→                end
   839→        end,
   840→    Names = lists:foldr(Process, [], BinParts),
   841→    decode_kex_init(Rest, [Names | Acc], N - 1).
   842→

   844→%%%================================================================
   845→%%%
   846→%%% Signature decode/encode
   847→%%%
   848→
   849→decode_signature(<<?DEC_BIN(Alg,__0), ?UINT32(_), Signature/binary>>) ->
   850→    {binary_to_list(Alg), Signature}.
   851→
   852→
   853→encode_signature(#'RSAPublicKey'{}, SigAlg, Signature) ->
   854→    SignName = list_to_binary(atom_to_list(SigAlg)),
   855→    <<?Ebinary(SignName), ?Ebinary(Signature)>>;
   856→encode_signature({_, #'Dss-Parms'{}}, _SigAlg, Signature) ->
   857→    <<?Ebinary(<<"ssh-dss">>), ?Ebinary(Signature)>>;
   858→encode_signature({#'ECPoint'{}, {namedCurve,OID}}, _SigAlg, Signature) ->
   859→    {SshCurveName,_} = oid2ssh_curvename(OID),
   860→    <<?Ebinary(<<SshCurveName/binary>>), ?Ebinary(Signature)>>.

   867→
   868→ssh_dbg_trace_points() -> [ssh_messages, raw_messages].
   869→
   870→ssh_dbg_flags(ssh_messages) -> [c];
   871→ssh_dbg_flags(raw_messages) -> [c].
   872→
   873→ssh_dbg_on(P) when P==ssh_messages ;
   874→                   P==raw_messages ->
   875→    dbg:tp(?MODULE,encode,1,x),
   876→    dbg:tp(?MODULE,decode,1,x).
   877→
   878→ssh_dbg_off(P) when P==ssh_messages ;
   879→                    P==raw_messages ->
   880→    dbg:ctpg(?MODULE,encode,1),
   881→    dbg:ctpg(?MODULE,decode,1).
   882→
   883→ssh_dbg_format(ssh_messages, {call,{?MODULE,encode,[Msg]}}) ->
   884→    Name = string:to_upper(atom_to_list(element(1,Msg))),
   885→    ["Going to send ",Name,":\n",
   886→     wr_record(ssh_dbg:shrink_bin(Msg))
   887→    ];
   888→ssh_dbg_format(ssh_messages, {return_from, {?MODULE,encode,1}, _Ret}) ->
   889→    skip;
   890→
   891→ssh_dbg_format(ssh_messages, {call, {?MODULE,decode,[_]}}) ->
   892→    skip;
   893→ssh_dbg_format(ssh_messages, {return_from,{?MODULE,decode,1},Msg}) ->
   894→    Name = string:to_upper(atom_to_list(element(1,Msg))),
   895→    ["Received ",Name,":\n",
   896→     wr_record(ssh_dbg:shrink_bin(Msg)),
   897→     case Msg of
   898→         #ssh_msg_userauth_request{service = "ssh-connection",
   899→                                   method = "publickey",
   900→                                   data = <<_,?DEC_BIN(Alg,__0),_/binary>>} ->
   901→             io_lib:format("  data decoded: ~s ... ~n", [Alg]);
   902→
   903→         #ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "env",
   904→                                  data = <<?DEC_BIN(Var,__0),?DEC_BIN(Val,__1)>>} ->
   905→             io_lib:format("  data decoded: ~s = ~s~n", [Var, Val]);
   906→
   907→         #ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "exec",
   908→                                  data = <<?DEC_BIN(Cmnd,__0)>>} ->
   909→             io_lib:format("  data decoded: ~s~n", [Cmnd]);
   910→
   911→         #ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "pty-req",
   912→                                  data = <<?DEC_BIN(BTermName,_TermLen),
   913→                                           ?UINT32(Width),?UINT32(Height),
   914→                                           ?UINT32(PixWidth), ?UINT32(PixHeight),
   915→                                           Modes/binary>>} ->
   916→             io_lib:format("  data decoded: terminal = ~s~n"
   917→                           "                width x height = ~p x ~p~n"
   918→                           "                pix-width x pix-height = ~p x ~p~n"
   919→                           "                pty-opts = ~p~n",
   920→                           [BTermName, Width,Height, PixWidth, PixHeight,
   921→                            ssh_connection:decode_pty_opts(Modes)]);
   922→         _ ->
   923→             ""
   924→     end
   925→    ];
   926→
   927→ssh_dbg_format(raw_messages, {call,{?MODULE,decode,[BytesPT]}}) ->
   928→    ["Received plain text bytes (shown after decryption):\n",
   929→     io_lib:format("~p",[BytesPT])
   930→    ];
   931→ssh_dbg_format(raw_messages, {return_from, {?MODULE,decode,1}, _Ret}) ->
   932→    skip;
   933→
   934→ssh_dbg_format(raw_messages, {call, {?MODULE,encode,[_]}}) ->
   935→    skip;
   936→ssh_dbg_format(raw_messages, {return_from,{?MODULE,encode,1},BytesPT}) ->
   937→    ["Going to send plain text bytes (shown before encryption):\n",
   938→     io_lib:format("~p",[BytesPT])
   939→    ].

    64→encode(#ssh_msg_global_request{
    65→	  name = Name,
    66→	  want_reply = Bool,
    67→	  data = Data}) ->
    68→    <<?Ebyte(?SSH_MSG_GLOBAL_REQUEST), ?Estring(Name), ?Eboolean(Bool), ?'E...'(Data)>>;
    69→
    70→encode(#ssh_msg_request_success{data = Data}) ->
    71→    <<?Ebyte(?SSH_MSG_REQUEST_SUCCESS), Data/binary>>;
    72→
    73→encode(#ssh_msg_request_failure{}) ->
    74→    <<?Ebyte(?SSH_MSG_REQUEST_FAILURE)>>;
    75→
    76→encode(#ssh_msg_channel_open{
    77→	  channel_type = Type,
    78→	  sender_channel = Sender,
    79→	  initial_window_size = Window,
    80→	  maximum_packet_size = Max,
    81→	  data = Data
    82→	 }) ->
    83→    <<?Ebyte(?SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_OPEN), ?Estring(Type), ?Euint32(Sender), ?Euint32(Window), ?Euint32(Max), ?'E...'(Data)>>;
    84→
    85→encode(#ssh_msg_channel_open_confirmation{
    86→	  recipient_channel = Recipient,
    87→	  sender_channel = Sender,
    88→	  initial_window_size = InitWindowSize,
    89→	  maximum_packet_size = MaxPacketSize,
    90→	  data = Data

   310→%% Connection Messages

   313→       name = Name,

   323→	 Data/binary>>) ->
   324→    #ssh_msg_channel_open{
   325→       channel_type = binary_to_list(Type),
   326→       sender_channel = Sender,

   329→       data = Data
   330→      };

   332→	 ?UINT32(InitWindowSize), ?UINT32(MaxPacketSize),
   333→	 Data/binary>>) ->
   334→    #ssh_msg_channel_open_confirmation{
   335→       recipient_channel = Recipient,
   336→       sender_channel = Sender,
   337→       initial_window_size = InitWindowSize,
   338→       maximum_packet_size = MaxPacketSize,
   339→       data = Data
   340→      };
   341→decode(<<?BYTE(?SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_OPEN_FAILURE),  ?UINT32(Recipient), ?UINT32(Reason),
   342→	 ?DEC_BIN(Desc,__0), ?DEC_BIN(Lang,__1) >> ) ->
   343→    #ssh_msg_channel_open_failure{
   344→       recipient_channel = Recipient,
   345→       reason = Reason,
   346→       description = ?unicode_list(Desc),
   347→       lang = Lang
   348→      };

   350→    #ssh_msg_channel_window_adjust{
   351→       recipient_channel = Recipient,
   352→       bytes_to_add = Bytes
   353→    };
   354→
   355→decode(<<?BYTE(?SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_DATA), ?UINT32(Recipient), ?DEC_BIN(Data,__0)>>) ->
   356→    #ssh_msg_channel_data{
   357→       recipient_channel = Recipient,
   358→       data = Data
   359→    };
   360→decode(<<?BYTE(?SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_EXTENDED_DATA), ?UINT32(Recipient), 
   361→	 ?UINT32(DataType), ?DEC_BIN(Data,__0)>>) ->
   362→    #ssh_msg_channel_extended_data{
   363→       recipient_channel = Recipient,
   364→       data_type_code = DataType,

   366→      };

   372→    #ssh_msg_channel_close{
   373→       recipient_channel = Recipient
   374→      };
   375→decode(<<?BYTE(?SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_REQUEST), ?UINT32(Recipient),
   376→	 ?DEC_BIN(RequestType,__0), ?BYTE(Bool), Data/binary>>=Bytes) ->
   377→    try
   378→        #ssh_msg_channel_request{
   379→           recipient_channel = Recipient,
   380→           request_type = ?unicode_list(RequestType),
   381→           want_reply = erl_boolean(Bool),
   382→           data  = Data
   383→          }
   384→    catch _:_ ->
   385→            %% Faulty, RFC4254 says:
   386→            %% "If the request is not recognized or is not
   387→            %% supported for the channel, SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_FAILURE is returned."
   388→            %% So we provoke such a message to be sent
   389→            #ssh_msg_channel_request{
   390→               recipient_channel = Recipient,
   391→               request_type = faulty_msg,
   392→               data = Bytes
   393→              }
   394→    end;

   396→    #ssh_msg_channel_success{
   397→       recipient_channel = Recipient
   398→      };

   400→    #ssh_msg_channel_failure{
   401→       recipient_channel = Recipient
   402→      };

%% Quick fix of failing test case (ssh_options_SUITE:ssh_msg_debug_fun_option_{client|server}/1)
handle_event(cast, #ssh_msg_debug{} = Msg, State, D) ->
    handle_event(internal, Msg, State, D);

handle_event(internal, #ssh_msg_debug{} = Msg, _StateName, D) ->
    debug_fun(Msg, D),
    keep_state_and_data;

handle_event(internal, {conn_msg,Msg}, StateName, #data{connection_state = Connection0,
                                                        event_queue = Qev0} = D0) ->
    Role = ?role(StateName),
    Rengotation = renegotiation(StateName),
    try ssh_connection:handle_msg(Msg, Connection0, Role, D0#data.ssh_params) of
	{disconnect, Reason0, RepliesConn} ->
            {Repls, D} = send_replies(RepliesConn, D0),
            case {Reason0,Role} of
                {{_, Reason}, client} when ((StateName =/= {connected,client})
                                            and (not Rengotation)) ->
                    handshake({not_connected,Reason}, D);
                _ ->
                    ok
            end,
            {stop_and_reply, {shutdown,normal}, Repls, D};

	{Replies, Connection} when is_list(Replies) ->
	    {Repls, D} = 
		case StateName of
		    {connected,_} ->
			send_replies(Replies, D0#data{connection_state=Connection});
		    _ ->
			{ConnReplies, NonConnReplies} = lists:splitwith(fun not_connected_filter/1, Replies),
			send_replies(NonConnReplies, D0#data{event_queue = Qev0 ++ ConnReplies})
		end,
            case {Msg, StateName} of
                {#ssh_msg_channel_close{}, {connected,_}} ->
                    {keep_state, D, [cond_set_idle_timer(D)|Repls]};
                {#ssh_msg_channel_success{}, _} ->
                    update_inet_buffers(D#data.socket),
                    {keep_state, D, Repls};
                _ ->
                    {keep_state, D, Repls}
            end

    catch
	Class:Error ->
            {Repls, D1} = send_replies(ssh_connection:handle_stop(Connection0), D0),
            {Shutdown, D} = ?send_disconnect(?SSH_DISCONNECT_BY_APPLICATION,
                                             io_lib:format("Internal error: ~p:~p",[Class,Error]),
                                             StateName, D1),
            {stop_and_reply, Shutdown, Repls, D}
    end;


handle_event(enter, OldState, {connected,_}=NewState, D) ->
    %% Entering the state where re-negotiation is possible
    init_renegotiate_timers(OldState, NewState, D);

handle_event(enter, OldState, {ext_info,_,renegotiate}=NewState, D) ->
    %% Could be hanging in exit_info state if nothing else arrives
    init_renegotiate_timers(OldState, NewState, D);

handle_event(enter, {connected,_}=OldState, NewState, D) ->
    %% Exiting the state where re-negotiation is possible
    pause_renegotiate_timers(OldState, NewState, D);

handle_event(cast, force_renegotiate, StateName, D) ->
    handle_event({timeout,renegotiate}, undefined, StateName, D);

handle_event({timeout,renegotiate}, _, StateName, D0) ->
    case StateName of
        {connected,Role} ->
            start_rekeying(Role, D0);
        {ext_info,Role,renegotiate} ->
            start_rekeying(Role, D0);
        _ ->
            %% Wrong state for starting a renegotiation, must be in re-negotiation
            keep_state_and_data
    end;

handle_event({timeout,check_data_size}, _, StateName, D0) ->
    %% Rekey due to sent data limit reached? (Can't be in {ext_info,...} if data is sent)
    case StateName of
        {connected,Role} ->
            check_data_rekeying(Role, D0);
        _ ->
            %% Wrong state for starting a renegotiation, must be in re-negotiation
            keep_state_and_data
    end;

handle_event({call,From}, get_alg, _, D) ->
    #ssh{algorithms=Algs} = D#data.ssh_params,
    {keep_state_and_data, [{reply,From,Algs}]};

handle_event(cast, _, StateName, _) when not ?CONNECTED(StateName) ->
    {keep_state_and_data, [postpone]};

handle_event(cast, {adjust_window,ChannelId,Bytes}, StateName, D) when ?CONNECTED(StateName) ->
    case ssh_client_channel:cache_lookup(cache(D), ChannelId) of
	#channel{recv_window_size = WinSize,
		 recv_window_pending = Pending,
		 recv_packet_size = PktSize} = Channel
	  when (WinSize-Bytes) >= 2*PktSize ->
	    %% The peer can send at least two more *full* packet, no hurry.
	    ssh_client_channel:cache_update(cache(D),
				     Channel#channel{recv_window_pending = Pending + Bytes}),
	    keep_state_and_data;

	#channel{recv_window_size = WinSize,
		 recv_window_pending = Pending,
		 remote_id = Id} = Channel ->
	    %% Now we have to update the window - we can't receive so many more pkts
	    ssh_client_channel:cache_update(cache(D),
				     Channel#channel{recv_window_size =

handle_event(internal, {conn_msg,Msg}, StateName, #data{connection_state = Connection0,
                                                        event_queue = Qev0} = D0) ->
    Role = ?role(StateName),
    Rengotation = renegotiation(StateName),
    try ssh_connection:handle_msg(Msg, Connection0, Role, D0#data.ssh_params) of
	{disconnect, Reason0, RepliesConn} ->
            {Repls, D} = send_replies(RepliesConn, D0),
            case {Reason0,Role} of
                {{_, Reason}, client} when ((StateName =/= {connected,client})
                                            and (not Rengotation)) ->
                    handshake({not_connected,Reason}, D);
                _ ->
                    ok
            end,
            {stop_and_reply, {shutdown,normal}, Repls, D};

	{Replies, Connection} when is_list(Replies) ->
	    {Repls, D} = 
		case StateName of
		    {connected,_} ->
			send_replies(Replies, D0#data{connection_state=Connection});
		    _ ->
			{ConnReplies, NonConnReplies} = lists:splitwith(fun not_connected_filter/1, Replies),
			send_replies(NonConnReplies, D0#data{event_queue = Qev0 ++ ConnReplies})
		end,
            case {Msg, StateName} of
                {#ssh_msg_channel_close{}, {connected,_}} ->
                    {keep_state, D, [cond_set_idle_timer(D)|Repls]};
                {#ssh_msg_channel_success{}, _} ->
                    update_inet_buffers(D#data.socket),
                    {keep_state, D, Repls};
                _ ->
                    {keep_state, D, Repls}
            end

    catch
	Class:Error ->
            {Repls, D1} = send_replies(ssh_connection:handle_stop(Connection0), D0),
            {Shutdown, D} = ?send_disconnect(?SSH_DISCONNECT_BY_APPLICATION,

    pause_renegotiate_timers(OldState, NewState, D);

{[{connection_reply, FailMsg}], Connection};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "exit-status",
				    data = Data},
           Connection, _, _SSH) ->
    <<?UINT32(Status)>> = Data,
    reply_msg(ChannelId, Connection, {exit_status, ChannelId, Status});

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "exit-signal",
				    want_reply = false,
				    data = Data},
           #connection{channel_cache = Cache} = Connection0, _, _SSH) ->
    <<?DEC_BIN(SigName, _SigLen),
      ?BOOLEAN(_Core),
      ?DEC_BIN(Err, _ErrLen),
      ?DEC_BIN(Lang, _LangLen)>> = Data,
    case ssh_client_channel:cache_lookup(Cache, ChannelId) of
        #channel{remote_id = RemoteId} = Channel ->
            {Reply, Connection} =  reply_msg(Channel, Connection0,
                                             {exit_signal, ChannelId,
                                              binary_to_list(SigName),
                                              binary_to_list(Err),
                                              binary_to_list(Lang)}),
            ChannelCloseMsg = channel_close_msg(RemoteId),
            {[{connection_reply, ChannelCloseMsg}|Reply], Connection};
        _ ->
            %% Channel already closed by peer
            {[], Connection0}
    end;

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "xon-xoff",
				    want_reply = false,
				    data = Data},
           Connection, _, _SSH) ->
    <<?BOOLEAN(CDo)>> = Data,
    reply_msg(ChannelId, Connection, {xon_xoff, ChannelId, CDo=/= 0});

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "window-change",
				    want_reply = false,
				    data = Data}, 
           Connection0, _, _SSH) ->
    <<?UINT32(Width),?UINT32(Height),
      ?UINT32(PixWidth), ?UINT32(PixHeight)>> = Data,
    reply_msg(ChannelId, Connection0, {window_change, ChannelId,
                                       Width, Height,
                                       PixWidth, PixHeight});

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "signal",
				    data = Data}, 
           Connection0, _, _SSH) ->
    <<?DEC_BIN(SigName, _SigLen)>> = Data,
    reply_msg(ChannelId, Connection0, {signal, ChannelId,
                                       binary_to_list(SigName)});

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "subsystem",
				    want_reply = WantReply,
				    data = Data},
	   #connection{channel_cache = Cache} = Connection, server, _SSH) ->
    <<?DEC_BIN(SsName,_SsLen)>> = Data,
    #channel{remote_id=RemoteId} = Channel = 
	ssh_client_channel:cache_lookup(Cache, ChannelId), 
    Reply =
        case start_subsystem(SsName, Connection, Channel,
                             {subsystem, ChannelId, WantReply, binary_to_list(SsName)}) of
            {ok, Pid} ->
                erlang:monitor(process, Pid),
                ssh_client_channel:cache_update(Cache, Channel#channel{user=Pid}),
                channel_success_msg(RemoteId);
            {error,_Error} ->
                channel_failure_msg(RemoteId)
        end,
    {[{connection_reply,Reply}], Connection};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "subsystem"},
	   Connection, client, _SSH) ->
    %% The client SHOULD ignore subsystem requests. See RFC 4254 6.5.
    {[], Connection};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "pty-req",
				    want_reply = WantReply,
				    data = Data},
	   Connection, server, _SSH) ->
    <<?DEC_BIN(BTermName,_TermLen),
      ?UINT32(Width),?UINT32(Height),
      ?UINT32(PixWidth), ?UINT32(PixHeight),
      Modes/binary>> = Data,
    TermName = binary_to_list(BTermName),
    PtyOpts0 = decode_pty_opts(Modes),
    PtyOpts = case proplists:get_value(onlcr, PtyOpts0, undefined) of
                  undefined ->
                      %% If - peer client asked for pty
                      %%    - did not tell if LF->CRLF expansion is wanted
                      %% then
                      %%    - do LF->CRLF expansion
                      [{onlcr,1} | PtyOpts0];
                  _ ->
                      PtyOpts0
              end,
    PtyRequest = {TermName, Width, Height,
		  PixWidth, PixHeight, PtyOpts},
    handle_cli_msg(Connection, ChannelId,
		   {pty, ChannelId, WantReply, PtyRequest});

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "pty-req"},
	   Connection, client, _SSH) ->
    %% The client SHOULD ignore pty requests. See RFC 4254 6.2.
    {[], Connection};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "shell",
				    want_reply = WantReply},
	   Connection, server, _SSH) ->
    handle_cli_msg(Connection, ChannelId,
		   {shell, ChannelId, WantReply});
 
handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "shell"},
	   Connection, client, _SSH) ->
    %% The client SHOULD ignore shell requests. See RFC 4254 6.5.
    {[], Connection};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "exec",
				    want_reply = WantReply,
				    data = Data},
	   Connection, server, _SSH) ->
    <<?DEC_BIN(Command, _Len)>> = Data,
    handle_cli_msg(Connection, ChannelId,
		   {exec, ChannelId, WantReply, binary_to_list(Command)});
	
handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "exec"},
	   Connection, client, _SSH) ->
    %% The client SHOULD ignore exec requests. See RFC 4254 6.5.
    {[], Connection};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
  				    request_type = "env",
  				    want_reply = WantReply,
  				    data = Data}, 
	   Connection, server, _SSH) ->
    <<?DEC_BIN(Var,_VarLen), ?DEC_BIN(Value,_ValLen)>> = Data,
    handle_cli_msg(Connection, ChannelId,
 		   {env, ChannelId, WantReply, Var, Value});

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "env"},
	   Connection, client, _SSH) ->
    %% The client SHOULD ignore env requests. 
    {[], Connection};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
                                    want_reply = WantReply},
	   #connection{channel_cache = Cache} = Connection, _, _SSH) ->
    %% Not a valid request_type. All valid types are handling the
    %% parameter checking in their own clauses above.
    %% 
    %% The special ReqType faulty_msg signals that something went
    %% wrong found during decoding.
    %%
    %% RFC4254 5.4 says:
    %% "If 'want reply' is FALSE, no response will be sent to the request.
    %%  Otherwise, the recipient responds with either
    %%  SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_SUCCESS, SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_FAILURE, or request-specific
    %%  continuation messages.  If the request is not recognized or is not
    %%  supported for the channel, SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_FAILURE is returned."
    %%
    case ssh_client_channel:cache_lookup(Cache, ChannelId) of
        #channel{remote_id = RemoteId} when WantReply==true -> 
            FailMsg = channel_failure_msg(RemoteId),
            {[{connection_reply, FailMsg}], Connection};
        _ -> %% Channel has been closed or no reply is wanted
            {[], Connection}
    end;

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_global_request{name = <<"tcpip-forward">>,
				   want_reply = WantReply,
				   data = <<?DEC_BIN(ListenAddrStr,_Len),?UINT32(ListenPort)>>},
           #connection{options = Opts} = Connection, server, _SSH) ->
    case ?GET_OPT(tcpip_tunnel_out, Opts) of
        false ->
            %% This daemon instance has not enabled tcpip_forwarding
            {[{connection_reply, request_failure_msg()}], Connection};

        true ->
            ConnectionSup = ?GET_INTERNAL_OPT(connection_sup, Opts),
            FwdSup = ssh_connection_sup:tcpip_fwd_supervisor(ConnectionSup),
            ConnPid = self(),
            case ssh_tcpip_forward_acceptor:supervised_start(FwdSup,
                                                             {ListenAddrStr, ListenPort},
                                                             undefined,
                                                             "forwarded-tcpip", ssh_tcpip_forward_srv,
                                                             ConnPid) of
                {ok,ListenPort} when WantReply==true ->
                    {[{connection_reply, request_success_msg(<<>>)}], Connection};

                {ok,LPort} when WantReply==true ->
                    {[{connection_reply, request_success_msg(<<?UINT32(LPort)>>)}], Connection};

                {error,_} when WantReply==true ->
                    {[{connection_reply, request_failure_msg()}], Connection};

                _ when WantReply==true ->
                    {[{connection_reply, request_failure_msg()}], Connection};

                _ ->
                    {[], Connection}
            end
    end;

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_global_request{name = _Type,
				   want_reply = WantReply,
				   data = _Data}, Connection, _Role, _SSH) ->
    if WantReply == true ->
	    FailMsg = request_failure_msg(),
	    {[{connection_reply, FailMsg}], Connection};
       true ->
	    {[], Connection}  
    end;

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_request_failure{},
	   #connection{requests = [{_, From} | Rest]} = Connection, _, _SSH) ->
    {[{channel_request_reply, From, {failure, <<>>}}],
     Connection#connection{requests = Rest}};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_request_failure{},
	   #connection{requests = [{_, From,_} | Rest]} = Connection, _, _SSH) ->
    {[{channel_request_reply, From, {failure, <<>>}}],
     Connection#connection{requests = Rest}};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_request_success{data = Data},
	   #connection{requests = [{_, From} | Rest]} = Connection, _, _SSH) ->
    {[{channel_request_reply, From, {success, Data}}],
     Connection#connection{requests = Rest}};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_request_success{data = Data},
	   #connection{requests = [{_, From, Fun} | Rest]} = Connection0, _, _SSH) ->
    Connection = Fun({success,Data}, Connection0),
    {[{channel_request_reply, From, {success, Data}}],
     Connection#connection{requests = Rest}};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_disconnect{code = Code,
			       description = Description},
	   Connection, _, _SSH) ->
    {disconnect, {Code, Description}, handle_stop(Connection)}.


%%%----------------------------------------------------------------
%%% Returns pending responses to be delivered to the peer when a
%%% Channel/Connection closes
%%%
-doc false.
handle_stop(#connection{channel_cache = Cache} = Connection0) ->
    {Connection, Replies} = 
	ssh_client_channel:cache_foldl(
          fun(Channel, {Connection1, Acc}) ->
                  {Reply, Connection2} =
                      reply_msg(Channel, Connection1,
                                {closed, Channel#channel.local_id}),
                  {Connection2, Reply ++ Acc}
          end, {Connection0, []}, Cache),
    ssh_client_channel:cache_delete(Cache),
    {Replies, Connection}.

%%%----------------------------------------------------------------
%%% channel_*_msg(...)
%%% Returns a #ssh_msg_....{} for channel operations.
%%%
-doc false.
channel_adjust_window_msg(ChannelId, Bytes) ->
    #ssh_msg_channel_window_adjust{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				   bytes_to_add = Bytes}.

-doc false.
channel_close_msg(ChannelId) ->
    #ssh_msg_channel_close {recipient_channel = ChannelId}.

-doc false.
channel_data_msg(ChannelId, 0, Data) ->
    #ssh_msg_channel_data{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
			  data = Data};
channel_data_msg(ChannelId, Type, Data) ->
    #ssh_msg_channel_extended_data{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    data_type_code = Type,
				    data = Data}.

-doc false.
channel_eof_msg(ChannelId) ->
    #ssh_msg_channel_eof{recipient_channel = ChannelId}.

-doc false.
channel_failure_msg(ChannelId) ->
    #ssh_msg_channel_failure{recipient_channel = ChannelId}.

-doc false.

{[{connection_reply, FailMsg}], Connection};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "exit-status",
				    data = Data},
           Connection, _, _SSH) ->
    <<?UINT32(Status)>> = Data,
    reply_msg(ChannelId, Connection, {exit_status, ChannelId, Status});

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "exit-signal",
				    want_reply = false,
				    data = Data},
           #connection{channel_cache = Cache} = Connection0, _, _SSH) ->
    <<?DEC_BIN(SigName, _SigLen),
      ?BOOLEAN(_Core),
      ?DEC_BIN(Err, _ErrLen),
      ?DEC_BIN(Lang, _LangLen)>> = Data,
    case ssh_client_channel:cache_lookup(Cache, ChannelId) of
        #channel{remote_id = RemoteId} = Channel ->
            {Reply, Connection} =  reply_msg(Channel, Connection0,
                                             {exit_signal, ChannelId,
                                              binary_to_list(SigName),
                                              binary_to_list(Err),
                                              binary_to_list(Lang)}),
            ChannelCloseMsg = channel_close_msg(RemoteId),
            {[{connection_reply, ChannelCloseMsg}|Reply], Connection};
        _ ->
            %% Channel already closed by peer
            {[], Connection0}
    end;

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "xon-xoff",
				    want_reply = false,
				    data = Data},
           Connection, _, _SSH) ->
    <<?BOOLEAN(CDo)>> = Data,
    reply_msg(ChannelId, Connection, {xon_xoff, ChannelId, CDo=/= 0});

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "window-change",
				    want_reply = false,
				    data = Data}, 
           Connection0, _, _SSH) ->
    <<?UINT32(Width),?UINT32(Height),
      ?UINT32(PixWidth), ?UINT32(PixHeight)>> = Data,
    reply_msg(ChannelId, Connection0, {window_change, ChannelId,
                                       Width, Height,
                                       PixWidth, PixHeight});

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "signal",
				    data = Data}, 
           Connection0, _, _SSH) ->
    <<?DEC_BIN(SigName, _SigLen)>> = Data,
    reply_msg(ChannelId, Connection0, {signal, ChannelId,
                                       binary_to_list(SigName)});

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "subsystem",
				    want_reply = WantReply,
				    data = Data},
	   #connection{channel_cache = Cache} = Connection, server, _SSH) ->
    <<?DEC_BIN(SsName,_SsLen)>> = Data,
    #channel{remote_id=RemoteId} = Channel = 
	ssh_client_channel:cache_lookup(Cache, ChannelId), 
    Reply =
        case start_subsystem(SsName, Connection, Channel,
                             {subsystem, ChannelId, WantReply, binary_to_list(SsName)}) of
            {ok, Pid} ->
                erlang:monitor(process, Pid),
                ssh_client_channel:cache_update(Cache, Channel#channel{user=Pid}),
                channel_success_msg(RemoteId);
            {error,_Error} ->
                channel_failure_msg(RemoteId)
        end,
    {[{connection_reply,Reply}], Connection};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "subsystem"},
	   Connection, client, _SSH) ->
    %% The client SHOULD ignore subsystem requests. See RFC 4254 6.5.
    {[], Connection};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "pty-req",
				    want_reply = WantReply,
				    data = Data},
	   Connection, server, _SSH) ->
    <<?DEC_BIN(BTermName,_TermLen),
      ?UINT32(Width),?UINT32(Height),
      ?UINT32(PixWidth), ?UINT32(PixHeight),
      Modes/binary>> = Data,
    TermName = binary_to_list(BTermName),
    PtyOpts0 = decode_pty_opts(Modes),
    PtyOpts = case proplists:get_value(onlcr, PtyOpts0, undefined) of
                  undefined ->
                      %% If - peer client asked for pty
                      %%    - did not tell if LF->CRLF expansion is wanted
                      %% then
                      %%    - do LF->CRLF expansion
                      [{onlcr,1} | PtyOpts0];
                  _ ->
                      PtyOpts0
              end,
    PtyRequest = {TermName, Width, Height,
		  PixWidth, PixHeight, PtyOpts},
    handle_cli_msg(Connection, ChannelId,
		   {pty, ChannelId, WantReply, PtyRequest});

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "pty-req"},
	   Connection, client, _SSH) ->
    %% The client SHOULD ignore pty requests. See RFC 4254 6.2.
    {[], Connection};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "shell",
				    want_reply = WantReply},
	   Connection, server, _SSH) ->
    handle_cli_msg(Connection, ChannelId,
		   {shell, ChannelId, WantReply});
 
handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "shell"},
	   Connection, client, _SSH) ->
    %% The client SHOULD ignore shell requests. See RFC 4254 6.5.
    {[], Connection};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    request_type = "exec",
				    want_reply = WantReply,
				    data = Data},
	   Connection, server, _SSH) ->
    <<?DEC_BIN(Command, _Len)>> = Data,
    handle_cli_msg(Connection, ChannelId,
		   {exec, ChannelId, WantReply, binary_to_list(Command)});
	
handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "exec"},
	   Connection, client, _SSH) ->
    %% The client SHOULD ignore exec requests. See RFC 4254 6.5.
    {[], Connection};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
  				    request_type = "env",
  				    want_reply = WantReply,
  				    data = Data}, 
	   Connection, server, _SSH) ->
    <<?DEC_BIN(Var,_VarLen), ?DEC_BIN(Value,_ValLen)>> = Data,
    handle_cli_msg(Connection, ChannelId,
 		   {env, ChannelId, WantReply, Var, Value});

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "env"},
	   Connection, client, _SSH) ->
    %% The client SHOULD ignore env requests. 
    {[], Connection};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
                                    want_reply = WantReply},
	   #connection{channel_cache = Cache} = Connection, _, _SSH) ->
    %% Not a valid request_type. All valid types are handling the
    %% parameter checking in their own clauses above.
    %% 
    %% The special ReqType faulty_msg signals that something went
    %% wrong found during decoding.
    %%
    %% RFC4254 5.4 says:
    %% "If 'want reply' is FALSE, no response will be sent to the request.
    %%  Otherwise, the recipient responds with either
    %%  SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_SUCCESS, SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_FAILURE, or request-specific
    %%  continuation messages.  If the request is not recognized or is not
    %%  supported for the channel, SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_FAILURE is returned."
    %%
    case ssh_client_channel:cache_lookup(Cache, ChannelId) of
        #channel{remote_id = RemoteId} when WantReply==true -> 
            FailMsg = channel_failure_msg(RemoteId),
            {[{connection_reply, FailMsg}], Connection};
        _ -> %% Channel has been closed or no reply is wanted
            {[], Connection}
    end;

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_global_request{name = <<"tcpip-forward">>,
				   want_reply = WantReply,
				   data = <<?DEC_BIN(ListenAddrStr,_Len),?UINT32(ListenPort)>>},
           #connection{options = Opts} = Connection, server, _SSH) ->
    case ?GET_OPT(tcpip_tunnel_out, Opts) of
        false ->
            %% This daemon instance has not enabled tcpip_forwarding
            {[{connection_reply, request_failure_msg()}], Connection};

        true ->
            ConnectionSup = ?GET_INTERNAL_OPT(connection_sup, Opts),
            FwdSup = ssh_connection_sup:tcpip_fwd_supervisor(ConnectionSup),
            ConnPid = self(),
            case ssh_tcpip_forward_acceptor:supervised_start(FwdSup,
                                                             {ListenAddrStr, ListenPort},
                                                             undefined,
                                                             "forwarded-tcpip", ssh_tcpip_forward_srv,
                                                             ConnPid) of
                {ok,ListenPort} when WantReply==true ->
                    {[{connection_reply, request_success_msg(<<>>)}], Connection};

                {ok,LPort} when WantReply==true ->
                    {[{connection_reply, request_success_msg(<<?UINT32(LPort)>>)}], Connection};

                {error,_} when WantReply==true ->
                    {[{connection_reply, request_failure_msg()}], Connection};

                _ when WantReply==true ->
                    {[{connection_reply, request_failure_msg()}], Connection};

                _ ->
                    {[], Connection}
            end
    end;

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_global_request{name = _Type,
				   want_reply = WantReply,
				   data = _Data}, Connection, _Role, _SSH) ->
    if WantReply == true ->
	    FailMsg = request_failure_msg(),
	    {[{connection_reply, FailMsg}], Connection};
       true ->
	    {[], Connection}  
    end;

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_request_failure{},
	   #connection{requests = [{_, From} | Rest]} = Connection, _, _SSH) ->
    {[{channel_request_reply, From, {failure, <<>>}}],
     Connection#connection{requests = Rest}};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_request_failure{},
	   #connection{requests = [{_, From,_} | Rest]} = Connection, _, _SSH) ->
    {[{channel_request_reply, From, {failure, <<>>}}],
     Connection#connection{requests = Rest}};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_request_success{data = Data},
	   #connection{requests = [{_, From} | Rest]} = Connection, _, _SSH) ->
    {[{channel_request_reply, From, {success, Data}}],
     Connection#connection{requests = Rest}};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_request_success{data = Data},
	   #connection{requests = [{_, From, Fun} | Rest]} = Connection0, _, _SSH) ->
    Connection = Fun({success,Data}, Connection0),
    {[{channel_request_reply, From, {success, Data}}],
     Connection#connection{requests = Rest}};

handle_msg(#ssh_msg_disconnect{code = Code,
			       description = Description},
	   Connection, _, _SSH) ->
    {disconnect, {Code, Description}, handle_stop(Connection)}.


%%%----------------------------------------------------------------
%%% Returns pending responses to be delivered to the peer when a
%%% Channel/Connection closes
%%%
-doc false.
handle_stop(#connection{channel_cache = Cache} = Connection0) ->
    {Connection, Replies} = 
	ssh_client_channel:cache_foldl(
          fun(Channel, {Connection1, Acc}) ->
                  {Reply, Connection2} =
                      reply_msg(Channel, Connection1,
                                {closed, Channel#channel.local_id}),
                  {Connection2, Reply ++ Acc}
          end, {Connection0, []}, Cache),
    ssh_client_channel:cache_delete(Cache),
    {Replies, Connection}.

%%% Returns a #ssh_msg_....{} for channel operations.
%%%
-doc false.
channel_adjust_window_msg(ChannelId, Bytes) ->

-doc false.
channel_close_msg(ChannelId) ->
    #ssh_msg_channel_close {recipient_channel = ChannelId}.

-doc false.
channel_data_msg(ChannelId, 0, Data) ->
    #ssh_msg_channel_data{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
			  data = Data};
channel_data_msg(ChannelId, Type, Data) ->
    #ssh_msg_channel_extended_data{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
				    data_type_code = Type,
				    data = Data}.

-doc false.
channel_eof_msg(ChannelId) ->
    #ssh_msg_channel_eof{recipient_channel = ChannelId}.

-doc false.
channel_failure_msg(ChannelId) ->
    #ssh_msg_channel_failure{recipient_channel = ChannelId}.

  1085→    #channel{remote_id=RemoteId} = Channel = 
  1086→	ssh_client_channel:cache_lookup(Cache, ChannelId),

  1088→        case start_subsystem(SsName, Connection, Channel,
  1089→                             {subsystem, ChannelId, WantReply, binary_to_list(SsName)}) of
  1090→            {ok, Pid} ->
  1091→                erlang:monitor(process, Pid),
  1092→                ssh_client_channel:cache_update(Cache, Channel#channel{user=Pid}),
  1093→                channel_success_msg(RemoteId);
  1094→            {error,_Error} ->
  1095→                channel_failure_msg(RemoteId)
  1096→        end,
  1097→    {[{connection_reply,Reply}], Connection};

  1099→handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "subsystem"},
  1100→	   Connection, client, _SSH) ->
  1101→    %% The client SHOULD ignore subsystem requests. See RFC 4254 6.5.
  1102→    {[], Connection};
  1103→

  1105→				    request_type = "pty-req",
  1106→				    want_reply = WantReply,
  1107→				    data = Data},
  1108→	   Connection, server, _SSH) ->
  1109→    <<?DEC_BIN(BTermName,_TermLen),
  1110→      ?UINT32(Width),?UINT32(Height),
  1111→      ?UINT32(PixWidth), ?UINT32(PixHeight),
  1112→      Modes/binary>> = Data,
  1113→    TermName = binary_to_list(BTermName),
  1114→    PtyOpts0 = decode_pty_opts(Modes),
  1115→    PtyOpts = case proplists:get_value(onlcr, PtyOpts0, undefined) of
  1116→                  undefined ->
  1117→                      %% If - peer client asked for pty
  1118→                      %%    - did not tell if LF->CRLF expansion is wanted
  1119→                      %% then
  1120→                      %%    - do LF->CRLF expansion
  1121→                      [{onlcr,1} | PtyOpts0];
  1122→                  _ ->
  1123→                      PtyOpts0
  1124→              end,
  1125→    PtyRequest = {TermName, Width, Height,
  1126→		  PixWidth, PixHeight, PtyOpts},
  1127→    handle_cli_msg(Connection, ChannelId,
  1128→		   {pty, ChannelId, WantReply, PtyRequest});
  1129→
  1130→handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "pty-req"},
  1131→	   Connection, client, _SSH) ->
  1132→    %% The client SHOULD ignore pty requests. See RFC 4254 6.2.
  1133→    {[], Connection};
  1134→
  1135→handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
  1136→				    request_type = "shell",
  1137→				    want_reply = WantReply},
  1138→	   Connection, server, _SSH) ->
  1139→    handle_cli_msg(Connection, ChannelId,
  1140→		   {shell, ChannelId, WantReply});
  1141→

  1144→    %% The client SHOULD ignore shell requests. See RFC 4254 6.5.

  1146→
  1147→handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
  1148→				    request_type = "exec",
  1149→				    want_reply = WantReply,
  1150→				    data = Data},
  1151→	   Connection, server, _SSH) ->

  1153→    handle_cli_msg(Connection, ChannelId,
  1154→		   {exec, ChannelId, WantReply, binary_to_list(Command)});
  1155→	
  1156→handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "exec"},
  1157→	   Connection, client, _SSH) ->
  1158→    %% The client SHOULD ignore exec requests. See RFC 4254 6.5.
  1159→    {[], Connection};
  1160→
  1161→handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
  1162→  				    request_type = "env",
  1163→  				    want_reply = WantReply,
  1164→  				    data = Data}, 
  1165→	   Connection, server, _SSH) ->
  1166→    <<?DEC_BIN(Var,_VarLen), ?DEC_BIN(Value,_ValLen)>> = Data,
  1167→    handle_cli_msg(Connection, ChannelId,
  1168→ 		   {env, ChannelId, WantReply, Var, Value});
  1169→
  1170→handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{request_type = "env"},
  1171→	   Connection, client, _SSH) ->
  1172→    %% The client SHOULD ignore env requests. 
  1173→    {[], Connection};
  1174→
  1175→handle_msg(#ssh_msg_channel_request{recipient_channel = ChannelId,
  1176→                                    want_reply = WantReply},
  1177→	   #connection{channel_cache = Cache} = Connection, _, _SSH) ->
  1178→    %% Not a valid request_type. All valid types are handling the
  1179→    %% parameter checking in their own clauses above.
  1180→    %% 
  1181→    %% The special ReqType faulty_msg signals that something went
  1182→    %% wrong found during decoding.
  1183→    %%
  1184→    %% RFC4254 5.4 says:
  1185→    %% "If 'want reply' is FALSE, no response will be sent to the request.
  1186→    %%  Otherwise, the recipient responds with either
  1187→    %%  SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_SUCCESS, SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_FAILURE, or request-specific
  1188→    %%  continuation messages.  If the request is not recognized or is not
  1189→    %%  supported for the channel, SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_FAILURE is returned."
  1190→    %%
  1191→    case ssh_client_channel:cache_lookup(Cache, ChannelId) of
  1192→        #channel{remote_id = RemoteId} when WantReply==true -> 
  1193→            FailMsg = channel_failure_msg(RemoteId),
  1194→            {[{connection_reply, FailMsg}], Connection};
  1195→        _ -> %% Channel has been closed or no reply is wanted
  1196→            {[], Connection}
  1197→    end;
  1198→
  1199→handle_msg(#ssh_msg_global_request{name = <<"tcpip-forward">>,
  1200→				   want_reply = WantReply,
  1201→				   data = <<?DEC_BIN(ListenAddrStr,_Len),?UINT32(ListenPort)>>},
  1202→           #connection{options = Opts} = Connection, server, _SSH) ->

  1204→        false ->

  1206→            {[{connection_reply, request_failure_msg()}], Connection};
  1207→
  1208→        true ->

  1261→    Connection = Fun({success,Data}, Connection0),
  1262→    {[{channel_request_reply, From, {success, Data}}],
  1263→     Connection#connection{requests = Rest}};
  1264→
  1265→handle_msg(#ssh_msg_disconnect{code = Code,
